blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Living out of a suitcase in different cities across the globe, Alex Eala couldn’t hide her excitement about finally playing “closer to home.” After stops in Australia, the Middle East, Europe, and North America, Eala is now in Singapore to kick off the WTA Tour’s Asian swing. “I’m excited [to play in Singapore]. I’m closer to home, so I’m very happy,” said Eala during the Welcome Party on Sunday night at Hilton Orchard here.
